name: Abusive Relationships
overview: Scripture acknowledges the pain and conflict present in abusive relationships, urging believers to respond with gentleness to defuse anger and avoid contentious behavior (Proverbs 15:1, 21:9). It warns against close association with those given to anger, emphasizing the need for wise boundaries (Proverbs 22:24). God's redeeming love calls His people to trust in His protection and identity as His own (Isaiah 43:1), while the gospel mission includes healing the brokenhearted and setting free those who are bruised (Luke 4:18). When offenses occur, Scripture encourages private, loving confrontation aimed at restoration (Matthew 18:15).
